0.original: Alphinaud is keen to report back to the Admiral.

24.original: Speak with Merlwyb in the command room.

48.original: I don't know about you, but it was all I could do to stop myself punching Sicard in the smirking face whenever he opened his mouth.

49.original: Though I have some passing knowledge of prior events, I am yet ill qualified to meddle in Lominsan affairs. 'Twas not my place to argue with Sicard, much as I would have liked to.

50.original: Nay, it is for the Admiral to deal with him and the Bloody Executioners both. By bringing them to the negotiating table, we have played our part.

51.original: I thought myself the hunter, but it turns out I was the prey... A timely reminder that the pirate powers of Limsa Lominsa are not to be trifled with.

52.original: But all's well that ends well. G'raha Tia's timely provocation had the desired effect, and Sicard has agreed to a meeting. Let us hurry back to Limsa Lominsa and pass on his invitation to the Admiral.

53.original: Sicard does not want for confidence, that much is plain, but I have faith in the Admiral. She has dealt with far worse.

54.original: The <hex:021A020203>Astalicia<hex:021A020103> is the very last place for such a meeting. The Admiral will be marching right into the coeurl's den. <sigh> I hope we don't end up regretting this...

55.original: While we have no assurances Sicard will be amenable to reason, there can be no compromise without discussion.

56.original: There you are. We have eagerly awaited your return.

59.original: Welcome back, my friends. What news?

60.original: So they have been stealing crystals from the kobolds...

61.original: My thanks for solving the mystery, and securing a meeting besides.

62.original: Suffice to say, I accept Sicard's invitation. And I would have you join me as my guests.

63.original: The future of Limsa hangs upon the outcome of this meeting, and I would have the Scions present to bear witness.

64.original: When the discussion gave way to a duel, I feared what might unfold. Yet only a fool would underestimate the Admiral─as Sicard soon discovered.

65.original: While I don't condone what Sicard has been doing, I know how difficult it can be to change course. It took me long enough to join the Scions, didn't it.

66.original: There are times when one must stand one's ground, even if the cost of failure is beyond reckoning.

67.original: The Admiral did just that, and I have nothing but respect for her. As she continues to steer her nation through this period of transition, I pray the Navigator will see fit to fill her sails.

68.original: Like Mistbeard before him, Hyllfyr chose to trust the future of our nation to the Admiral. That was the moment, I believe, that the good ship Limsa Lominsa finally embarked upon her new course.

69.original: ...Though I had anticipated a duel, I did not foresee that Hyllfyr would intervene.

70.original: But full glad am I that he did. 'Twould have been a shame to kill the boy.

71.original: Instead, the whelp has learned a valuable lesson, and we have made peace amongst ourselves. All that remains is to do likewise with our neighbors.
